changelog.title: Live drag-to-reorder
changelog.description:
## Added

  • `Live drag-to-reorder` — cards visually swap in real time while holding and dragging, powered by onDragOver + synchronous dragOrderRef to avoid stale state.
  • `FLIP settle animation` — on drop, framer-motion layout animates each card to its final position with a 250ms ease-out spring.
  • `Drag lift effect` — the held card springs into a slightly scaled, rotated state using framer-motion, matching the motion.dev drag feel.
  • `README overhaul` — updated copy, fixed docs/MEMORY.md and docs/DESIGN.md paths, corrected roadmap link to Specs/ROADMAP.md.

## Changed

  • `Collision detection → pointerWithin` — swap only triggers when the pointer is physically inside another card's bounds; fixes diagonal move mis-fires and cross-column jumps.
  • `Drag architecture` — removed dnd-kit CSS transforms entirely; array order controls card positions, DragOverlay shows the floating ghost.

## Fixed

  • `Maximum update depth exceeded` — caused by rectSortingStrategy measuring DOM rects in a layout effect loop during rapid swaps. Reverted to verticalListSortingStrategy.
  • `Snap-back on drop` — handleDragEnd was reading stale localMemos closure; replaced with synchronous dragOrderRef that updates in the same tick as each swap.
  • `Up/down drag broken` — closestCenter was finding horizontally adjacent cards when dragging vertically; fixed by switching to pointerWithin.

changelog.title: panel fixes, search perf & docs
changelog.description:
## Bug fixes

  • `event.search` — refactored from O(n) per-event queries to a single LEFT JOIN; actors grouped in JS after one round-trip.
  • `Subject detail panel` — no longer blocked by loading state; opens immediately on pill click with loading indicator while data fetches.
  • `Subject detail panel (demo)` — builds subject + events from local data when no DB is connected.
  • `Subject detail panel (spine)` — timeline spine repositioned from mid-dates to right of dates, matching main timeline layout.
  • `Subject detail panel (sort)` — years now sorted newest-first, matching main timeline order.
  • `Subject detail panel (scroll)` — mouse wheel scroll now works; Lenis no longer intercepts events inside the panel.
  • `Settings page` — Export and About cards now side by side in the bento grid instead of stacked in one column.

## Documentation

  • `CONTRIBUTING.md` — added setup, workflow, code conventions, domain constants, known gaps.
  • `ROADMAP.md` — restructured with status key, versioned horizons, and all Settings page placeholders documented.
  • `.env.example` — corrected misleading comment on APP_SECRET.

changelog.title: alpha — static SVG, 3 insert modes, settings
changelog.description:
## Added

  • `Icon grid` — 263 icons fetched from GitHub Raw registry; 24h localStorage cache with offline fallback.
  • `Three insert modes` — Motion (ItsHover animated, static SVG extraction in this release), SvgIcon (static), CSS Stroke (basic stroke-draw).
  • `Hover-to-prefetch` — 200ms delay prefetch; drag-and-drop + click-to-insert via framer.addSVGNode(); clipboard fallback.
  • `Settings page` — theme toggle, default size slider (16–64px), default color picker + presets, cache clear.
  • `Category filters` — All, Arrows, Brand, Social, Letters, Tech filter chips.
  • `MotionGuide overlay` — shown for Motion insert mode.
  • `Toast notifications` — insert feedback toasts.
  • `Info page` — plugin and icon library attribution.

## Changed

  • `Plugin name` — renamed from "ItsHover Icons" to AnimIconSVG in framer.json.
  • `Design system` — Settings and Info pages aligned: same padding (12px), typography scale, section spacing, shared footer.

## Fixed

  • `Settings viewport` — condensed to fit 600px plugin height without scrollbar.
  • `Info page footer` — now pins to bottom of viewport.
  • `Missing dependency` — installed vite-plugin-framer dev dependency.

changelog.title: dashboard settings, layout cleanup, editor fixes
changelog.description:
## Added

  • `Dashboard grid density control` — 4/5 memo-card layout setting in SettingsPage so dashboard density can be changed from Settings.
  • `Grid preference persistence` — dashboardGridColumns state and setter to the app store so the chosen layout survives refreshes.
  • `Masonry dashboard` — masonry-style layout for the main dashboard to better accommodate variable memo card heights.
  • `Inline BAF action` — moved the BAF/Add New action beside the search bar for faster dashboard access.
  • `Full note-detail editing` — note detail editor, rendered markdown view, and toolbar improvements.
  • `Settings redesign foundation` — bento-style Settings redesign, creator/info cards, and supporting stats improvements.

## Changed

  • `Appearance settings flow` — dashboard grid control inside Appearance section with refined segmented control styling.
  • `Dashboard layout wiring` — MemoGrid now reads the saved dashboard grid preference instead of a hardcoded 5-column layout.
  • `Header and navigation polish` — dashboard top bar, inline controls, hamburger/header work, and homepage CSS refinements aligned.
  • `Memo card readability` — cleaned up memo card text hierarchy for clearer scanning.
  • `FAB behavior` — Speed Dial flow now aligns better with direct note creation and inline dashboard actions.

## Removed

  • `Floating FAB wiring` — removed from Layout.tsx along with stale related imports and unused state.
  • `MemoCast surface` — continued cleanup of MemoCast-facing navigation and routing in the active UI flow.
  • `Broken settings collapse` — removed inconsistent keyboard-shortcuts collapse behavior from Settings.

## Fixed

  • `Speed dial JSX` — fixed the broken JSX block in SpeedDialFAB.tsx.
  • `Hover animation jitter` — separated parent positioning transforms from child hover scale transforms in SpeedDialFAB.tsx.
  • `Duplicate store destructure` — removed the repeated useAppStore() destructure that caused redeclare issues.
  • `Store wiring for grid controls` — fixed missing app store state/setter pair so 4/5 dashboard buttons work correctly.
  • `Markdown paste and render` — preserved markdown syntax on paste, improved code block handling, tightened typography.
  • `Markdown editor view-first` — fixed read/view mode initialization and blur-save handling.
